subject.title: feat(agents): Swarm core — collector spawn, agents_wait, structured output, caps (gated)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this broad, persistent `tools.swarm` core API as the experimental v1 implementation of the Swarm program now?
rationale: The branch adds new core configuration, tool, gateway-protocol, scheduler, and durable-state contracts; the linked program issue describes the direction but does not by itself establish merge-time ownership of those long-lived public boundaries.

options.title: Sponsor gated Swarm v1
options.body: Accept the core direction, contingent on upgrade/restart proof and a clear owner for the experimental contract.

options.title: Narrow before landing
options.body: Split durable orchestration or public API pieces into smaller reviewed changes while retaining the program issue as the canonical plan.

options.title: Defer the core surface
options.body: Keep the program issue open and postpone this API until maintainer priorities and ownership are explicit.

recommendation.title: Sponsor gated Swarm v1
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction, contingent on upgrade/restart proof and a clear owner for the experimental contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The open program issue and this branch both identify steipete as the person currently carrying the Swarm design and implementation context.
